name: salasfms
description: Painel para agendamento de salas de aula - Faculdade Medicina do Sertao

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist'); ['index.html','aluno.html','styles.css','app2.js','aluno.js','ensalamento-data.js'].forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f, 'dist/' + f)); fs.cpSync('assets', 'dist/assets', { recursive: true }); console.log('Build complete');"
scripts.check: node --check app2.js; node --check aluno.js; node --check local-server.js; node --check api/reservations.js
